description: This file contains unit tests for the OrderService class in the ApplicationCore.Services namespace of the eShopOnWeb project. It includes tests for creating orders from baskets, handling missing baskets, and empty baskets.

classes.name: OrderServiceTests
classes.description: A class containing unit tests for the OrderService, testing order creation and error handling scenarios.

methods.name: CreatesOrderFromBasketItems
methods.description: Tests the ability of OrderService to create an order from basket items, verifying that an order is saved with the correct items.

methods.name: ThrowsWhenBasketMissing
methods.description: Tests that creating an order throws an ArgumentNullException when the basket is not found.

methods.name: ThrowsWhenBasketEmpty
methods.description: Tests that creating an order throws an EmptyBasketOnCheckoutException when the basket is empty.
